sources.citation: Zubair, Saeed. 2016. A phonological description of Wadiyari, a language spoken in Pakistan. MA thesis, Payap University, Chiang Mai (pp. 13-16, 27-28)
sources.note: About Wadiyari, not Jandavra. Mentions Jandavra only as one of 27 groups first reported in Jeffery (ed.) 1999 'Sindh Survey Month' (unpublished ms.), placed under E. Gujarati beside Jadgali in Jeffery's classification; states Jandavra was NOT covered by Grainger & Grainger 1980 and that Jeffery 1999 'does not provide any lists of consonants and vowels for any languages examined'. Grainger & Grainger 1980: 48 ('none of the languages has phonemic word or syllable-tone'; stress not marked, assumed predictable) covers other Sindh tribal languages, not Jandavra.
